Kira (People Ops): Heads-up: we're running a staggered SOC2/ISO evidence upload next week to avoid the usual last-minute scramble. Sign up for a 2h slot by EOD today.

Omar (Compliance): Please include the metadata checklist with each upload and name files like team_evidence_YYYYMMDD. If something's missing, flag it with an owner + ETA.

Lena (Eng): If two of our engineers are OOO Tue, can we ask for Wed morning?

Kira (People Ops): Yep — add the constraint on the sign-up sheet and choose "special-handling". We'll move teams into the vendor/exception lanes as needed.

Sam (Infra): I'll cover the infra lane Tue 10-12 and help revoke presigned URLs if wrong files are uploaded. Tag me.

DevBot: Automated reminders will ping 24h and 2h before your slot. React with :bell: to opt into extra pings.

Omar (Compliance): Minimum checklist: IAM screenshots, change ticket export, runbook PDF, vendor contract (if applicable), retention excerpt, privacy training CSV.

Kira (People Ops): Upload flow: sign-up -> presigned S3 URL via form -> auto metadata attach. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/teams/compliance/evidence-upload (SSO).

Lena (Eng): Thanks — signing up now and requesting Wed morning.

Kira (People Ops): Great. Leads, please assign by EOD. We'll run a short QA sweep Wed PM to spot-check uploads.
